# Minibot

> Minibot is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant for Telegram, built in Python.
> It provides persistent memory, tools, skills, scheduled automations, MCP integration,
> and multi-agent orchestration. Telegram-first, SQLite-first, async-first, auditable.

## Features

- Self-hosted Telegram AI assistant
- Persistent memory (SQLite)
- Agent tools: Python, Bash, HTTP, files, grep, patch editing
- Agent skills (Markdown)
- Multi-agent orchestration with delegation
- Scheduled prompts (one-shot, interval, cron)
- Async background task workers (SQLite or RabbitMQ)
- MCP integration
- RAG over SQLite or Qdrant
- Optional relation graph
- Browser automation (Playwright)
- Voice (speech-to-text)
- Python extensions for tools, events, services, and channels
